{{Top|leg}}
'''Holo-Gaftikar Channel Ten''' was one of the primary news-reporting agencies based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gaftikar]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Headquartered in [[Eyat]], the Channel Ten Tower was one of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] main targets during the [[Battle of Gaftikar|occupation of Gaftikar]].

[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Tel (clone trooper)|Tel]] and [[Omega Squad]] infiltrated the facility to find it still broadcasting. The building was set to detonate upon a door-breach; the Republic troops tried to evacuate in time, but several members of the group were injured when the facility exploded.
